title: Affine spectrum stalk ring and ordinary tensor complex coordinates
statement: Let $f:X\to S$, $f':X'\to S'$, $g:S'\to S$, $g':X'\to X$ be a cartesian square of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme], and suppose their spectrum maps on global sections also form a cartesian square. Fix sheaf derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], a complex $P$ of modules on $X$, $z_0\in\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(X',\top)$ and $i\in\mathbf Z$. Put $j=X'.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1}$, $z=j(z_0)$, $P_0=(X.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1})^*P$ and $P_g=(g')^*P$ termwise. Write $R,A,B,D$ and $R_0,A_0,B_0,D_0$ for the two sets of four stalk rings and their structural maps [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition], $Q=P_{g'(z)}$, $Q_0=(P_0)_{g'_0(z_0)}$, and $V=D\otimes_A Q$, $V_0=D_0\otimes_{A_0}Q_0$ for tensorComplex. There exist ring isomorphisms $e_R,e_A,e_B,e_D$, commuting with the R-to-A and R-to-B maps and satisfying $e_D(\mu(a\otimes b))=\mu_0(e_A(a)\otimes e_B(b))$, and chain isomorphisms $q:Q\cong\operatorname{Res}_{e_A}Q_0$, $t:V\cong\operatorname{Res}_{e_D}V_0$ with $t^k(d\otimes x)=e_D(d)\otimes q^k(x)$. Let $F,F_0$ forget scalars to additive groups, $c_i:H^i(\operatorname{Res}_{e_D}V_0)\cong\operatorname{Res}_{e_D}H^i(V_0)$ be exact restriction homology, $s,s_0$ the tensorStalkIso maps [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition], and $\alpha:(g'_0)^*P_0\cong j^*P_g$ the ordinary pullback composition isomorphism [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso]. Let $U$ be the additive ordinary homology isomorphism along $j$, constructed by conjugating homology of isoPullbackAdditiveStalkIso [lem-pc-iso-pullback-stalk-cohomology] by exact additive stalk cohomology factors and comparisonStalkHomologyIso. Then $F(H^i(t));F(c_i);F_0(H^i(s_0))=F(H^i(s));U;F_0(H^i((\operatorname{stalk}_{z_0}\alpha^{-1})))$. This is solely a statement about stalk rings and ordinary complexes; it asserts nothing about a derived tensor cohomology source or its counit.

proof.text: Use isoSpec naturality to identify the four points. The stalk maps of isoSpec inverses, with stalkCongr for equal points, give the four ring equivalences. stalkMap_comp gives compatibility of the structural maps. The two restrictions of tensorMap give compatibility on pure tensors.

The pullback-stalk germ isomorphism along the coordinate isomorphism gives q. Define t on pure tensors by eD(d) tensor q(x). Balancing follows from the structural-map equations, naturality gives differential compatibility, and the inverse formula with the inverse ring isomorphisms proves invertibility by tensor induction.

The pullback-stalk germ formulas and the adjunction-mate composition formula identify the induced ordinary stalk chain map with isoPullbackAdditiveStalkIso followed by the stalk of alpha.inv. Apply homology and exact restriction homology, using the explicit ordinaryIsoPullbackStalkHomologyIso factors.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affineSpectrum_tensor_coordinates
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine X'] [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S']
    (sq0 : IsPullback (Spec.map g'.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
      (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g.appTop))
    (z0 : Spec Γ(X', ⊤)) (i : ℤ)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    let z := X'.isoSpec.inv z0
    let P0 := ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback X.isoSpec.inv).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let Pg := ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let j := X'.isoSpec.inv
    let S0 := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor (Spec Γ(X', ⊤)).toRingedSpace z0
    let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X'.presheaf.stalk z)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let F0 := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((Spec Γ(X', ⊤)).presheaf.stalk z0))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let alpha := (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackCompositionIso (Spec.map g'.appTop) X.isoSpec.inv
        ((Spec.map g'.appTop) ≫ X.isoSpec.inv) rfl).symm ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackCompositionIso j g'
        ((Spec.map g'.appTop) ≫ X.isoSpec.inv) (Scheme.isoSpec_inv_naturality g').symm)
      (.up ℤ)).app P
    letI := leftAlgebra f g' z
    letI := rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq z
    letI := (tensorMap f f' g g' sq z).toAlgebra
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (R f g' z))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (B f' z))
    letI := leftAlgebra (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) z0
    letI := rightAlgebra (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
      (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) sq0 z0
    letI := (tensorMap (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
      (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) sq0 z0).toAlgebra
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (ModuleCat.{u} (R (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) z0))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (B (Spec.map f'.appTop) z0))
    let R0 := R (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) z0
    let A0 := A (Spec.map g'.appTop) z0
    let B0 := B (Spec.map f'.appTop) z0
    let D0 := C z0
    let Q := stalkComplex g' z P
    let Q0 := stalkComplex (Spec.map g'.appTop) z0 P0
    let V0 := tensorComplex (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
      (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) sq0 z0 P0
    ∃ (eR : R f g' z ≃+* R0) (eA : A g' z ≃+* A0)
      (eB : B f' z ≃+* B0) (eD : C z ≃+* D0)
      (q : Q ≅ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} eA.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj Q0)
      (t : tensorComplex f f' g g' sq z P ≅
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} eD.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj V0),
      (∀ r : R f g' z,
        eA (algebraMap (R f g' z) (A g' z) r) = algebraMap R0 A0 (eR r)) ∧
      (∀ r : R f g' z,
        eB (algebraMap (R f g' z) (B f' z) r) = algebraMap R0 B0 (eR r)) ∧
      (∀ (a : A g' z) (b : B f' z),
        eD (algebraMap (A g' z ⊗[R f g' z] B f' z) (C z) (a ⊗ₜ[R f g' z] b)) =
          algebraMap (A0 ⊗[R0] B0) D0 (eA a ⊗ₜ[R0] eB b)) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℤ) (d : C z) (x : Q.X k),
        t.hom.f k (d ⊗ₜ[A g' z, (tensorMap f f' g g' sq z).comp
          (algebraMap (A g' z) (A g' z ⊗[R f g' z] B f' z))] x) =
        eD d ⊗ₜ[A0, (tensorMap (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
          (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) sq0 z0).comp
          (algebraMap A0 (A0 ⊗[R0] B0))] (show Q0.X k from q.hom.f k x)) ∧
      F.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap t.hom i) ≫
          F.map ((V0.sc i).mapHomologyIso (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} eD.toRingHom)).hom ≫
          F0.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            (tensorStalkIso (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
              (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) sq0 z0 P0).hom i) =
        F.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (tensorStalkIso f f' g g' sq z P).hom i) ≫
          (ordinaryIsoPullbackStalkHomologyIso j z0 i Pg).hom ≫
          F0.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            ((S0.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map alpha.inv) i)
